script:

  --duration 5 --expect-reject 403 --save F29.ws-handshake-rejections/no-origin
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth none --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403 --save F29.ws-handshake-rejections/control-origin
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth none --header "Origin: $S" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header 'Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=qa-f29-bogus' --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$T2" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403 --save F29.ws-handshake-rejections/other-app
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth header --header "Origin: $S" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie>/ws --auth query --header "Origin: $S" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
